title: Generation of CRISPR/Cas9 ATG2A/ATG2B Knockout Cells
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Vector digestion with BbsI. Set up the following digestion reaction: 1 µg pSpCas9(BB)-2A-GFP or pSpCas9(BB)-2A-mCherry 1 µL BbsI (NEB, Cat# R0539S) 1 µL FastAP (Thermo Fisher, Cat# EF0654) 2 µL Buffer G (Thermo Fisher, Cat# BG5) Add sterile MilliQ H₂O to 20 µL total

Oligo phosphorylation and annealing. Mix: 1 µL Forward oligo ( 100 micromolar (µM) ) 1 µL Reverse oligo ( 100 micromolar (µM) ) 1 µL 10× T4 ligation buffer (NEB, Cat# B0202S) 6 µL H₂O 1 µL T4 PNK (NEB, Cat# M0201S)
Annealing protocol (thermocycler): 37 °C for 00:30:00 95 °C for 00:05:00 Ramp down to 25 °C at 5 °C/min
Grow colonies overnight in selective media.
Miniprep the plasmids the following day.
Use only sequence-verified constructs for transfection.
Identify knockout clones by Western blot . Antibodies used: Anti-ATG2A: Proteintech, Cat# 23226-1-AP Anti-ATG2B: Proteintech, Cat# 25155-1-AP Anti-GAPDH: Merck, Cat# G8795-25µL
Extract genomic DNA from candidate knockout (KO) clones.

steps.title: Design sgRNAs for ATG2A/B
steps.instruction: Use CRISPick (RRID:SCR_025148) with human GRCh38 reference, CRISPRko mechanism, spyoCas9 enzyme, on‑target scorer RS3seq‑Hsu2013+RS3target to identify sgRNAs targeting all common splicing variants of ATG2A and ATG2B. Selected sequences: ATG2A exon 21 sgRNA ACAGCAGTGGACAACATGTG; ATG2B exon 22 sgRNA TAGTAGGTTCCAACCAGTGT.

steps.title: Order and clone sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Order forward and reverse oligonucleotides for the selected sgRNA sequences from Microsynth. Clone each duplex into the BbsI‑digested vectors pSpCas9(BB)-2A‑GFP (Addgene #48138) and pSpCas9(BB)-2A‑mCherry (Addgene #197420).

steps.title: Anneal sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Mix forward and reverse oligos (as per vendor instructions) and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes to anneal.

steps.title: Dilute annealed oligos 1:200
steps.instruction: Dilute the annealed oligo duplex 1:200 with sterile H₂O.

steps.title: Set up ligation reaction
steps.instruction: In a 10 µL ligation set up: 50 ng BbsI‑digested plasmid (freshly purified), 1 µL diluted oligo duplex, 5 µL 2× Quick Ligase Buffer (NEB Cat# B2200SVIAL), add sterile H₂O to a total volume of 9 µL, then add 1 µL Quick Ligase (NEB Cat# M2200LVIAL). Mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the ligation at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transform ligation into DH5α
steps.instruction: Transform the ligation product into chemically competent E. coli DH5α (Thermo Fisher Cat# 18265017) using a standard heat‑shock protocol, plate on appropriate antibiotic, and grow overnight for plasmid preparation.

steps.title: Sequence plasmids to confirm insertion
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmid DNA from colonies and verify sgRNA insertion by Sanger sequencing using primer hU6‑f (ordered from Microsynth Standard Primer List).

steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: One day before transfection, seed 700,000 HAP1 or HeLa cells per well in a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare and add transfection mix
steps.instruction: Prepare two mixes: Mix A – 125 µL Opti‑MEM, 5 µL P3000 reagent, 2000 ng sgRNA‑GFP plasmid (A) plus 2000 ng sgRNA‑mCherry plasmid (B); Mix B – 125 µL Opti‑MEM, 5 µL Lipofectamine 3000 (Thermo Fisher Cat# L3000008). Combine Mix A and Mix B, incubate 10 minutes at room temperature, then add the mixture dropwise to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Mix A: combine Opti‑MEM, P3000, and both plasmids.
Mix B: combine Opti‑MEM and Lipofectamine 3000.
Combine Mix A with Mix B, incubate 10 min at RT.
Add the combined mix dropwise to the cultured cells.

steps.title: FACS sort GFP/mCherry positive cells
steps.instruction: 48 hours post‑transfection, sort single GFP‑positive and mCherry‑positive cells by FACS using a BD FACSMelody™ Cell Sorter into individual wells of a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: PCR amplify target loci
steps.instruction: Perform PCR on genomic DNA from each clone using the following primers: ATG2A – Forward ATGGTGGAAACTGGAGCTGA, Reverse GCAAGCCCATACCTTCACAT; ATG2B – Forward GCTCTCTCCTTCCCGTAAAC, Reverse ATTTTAACGGCAACAGACAGC.

steps.title: Sanger sequence PCR products
steps.instruction: Submit the PCR products for Sanger sequencing to confirm editing at the ATG2A and ATG2B target sites.
